name: Cooking/Food Tutorial
description: Fast-paced, satisfying cooking tutorial with step-by-step cooking shots and text callouts. Perfect for meal prep, recipes, and food hacks.
voice_style: casual, conversational, encouraging — like cooking with a friend who knows their stuff
music_mood: acoustic cooking beats, upbeat kitchen jazz, cook-along background music

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: This 15-minute recipe will save you $200 a month on takeout — and it's genuinely delicious.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Ingredients laid out on clean marble countertop, overhead shot, text overlay '15 min | $3/serving | Vegan', knife and cutting board ready
scene_sequence.camera_movement: static overhead shot with slight push-in, overhead angle for full ingredient spread
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: bright overhead kitchen light, white marble reflecting light evenly, clean white aesthetic, slight warm tint on ingredients
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Overhead ingredient spread is the gold standard food prep shot; clean marble surface reflects light beautifully

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: First: chop your aromatics — onion, garlic, ginger. The secret is a rough chop, not precise. We're not running a restaurant.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Hands chopping vegetables on board, knife moving fast, close-up of cutting board, steam rising from pan in background
scene_sequence.camera_movement: overhead static on cutting board, macro close-up on knife detail, steady overhead
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: overhead shadowless lighting on cutting board, slight side fill, warm wood tones of cutting board
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Overhead cutting shot is ASMR-satisfying; knife detail close-up adds premium production feel

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Get your pan hot first — 30 seconds before oil. Add oil, then garlic. You want to hear that sizzle, not silence.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Pan heating on stove, oil being poured, garlic hitting pan with sizzle, close-up of oil shimmering
scene_sequence.camera_movement: side angle medium shot of pan, macro close-up on oil shimmer, cut back to medium
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: stovetop overhead light, side key for oil sheen, steam rising with backlight, golden oil shimmer detail
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Oil shimmer detail shot is a proven engagement hook; side lighting shows the shimmer texture clearly

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Toss everything in. Stir. Walk away for 10 minutes — don't touch it. This is the hardest part of cooking: doing nothing.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Ingredients combined in pan, wooden spoon stirring, timer being set, person stepping back from stove, steam rising
scene_sequence.camera_movement: medium side shot of stir, match cut to person stepping back, steam time-lapse overlay option
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm stovetop ambient light, steam backlit, cozy warm kitchen tones throughout
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Walking-away moment has comedic timing value; steam rising in warm light creates cozy food content aesthetic

scene_sequence.narration_prompt: Plate it up. That smell? That's the smell of never ordering takeout again. Follow for more recipes that actually fit your life.
scene_sequence.visual_prompt: Final plated dish being garnished, close-up of texture and color, person picking up fork, text overlay with ingredient list
scene_sequence.camera_movement: slow cinematic tilt down from overhead plating shot to texture close-up, final medium close-up of person tasting
scene_sequence.lighting_setup: warm dramatic overhead light on food, dark background, golden food tones, macro depth on texture
scene_sequence.hailuo_style_note: Plating shot deserves the most lighting investment — dark background with single warm overhead light is magazine quality
